verdicts.reason: A breaks the message: the lines read PRAY / When Life Is Great / When Life Is Rough / PRAY, so the couplet is out of order and makes no sense. Its text is small and mixes left and centred alignment, and the divider sits alone at the bottom with no link to the copy, although the rose is large and kept in proportion. B keeps the reading order, but its text blocks are staggered with no shared axis and the divider is jammed beside 'When Life Is Great' instead of separating the two halves. The rose is crammed into the bottom-left corner and cut by the left edge, leaving the whole bottom-right quadrant empty, which makes the layout lopsided.
